summary: Cheche Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that Nasdaq granted an additional 180-day extension, until January 11, 2027, to regain compliance with the minimum $1.00 bid price rule. The company received the extension on July 14, 2026, after the initial compliance period expired July 13, 2026. No other terms, advisors, or structural details were disclosed. This is a routine Nasdaq compliance update, not a special situation; there is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting (yet), issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event. Watch for continued trading performance and potential delisting if compliance is not achieved by the new deadline.
